data: Tesla reported GAAP diluted earnings per share of $4.30 for fiscal 2023, up from $3.62 in fiscal 2022, an increase of about 18.8%. Net income attributable to common stockholders in fiscal 2023 was about $15.0 billion ($14,997 million), compared with $12.6 billion in fiscal 2022. The 2023 figure was boosted by a one-time non-cash tax benefit of roughly $5.9 billion from releasing a valuation allowance on deferred tax assets. Excluding that benefit, underlying profitability fell as price cuts squeezed margins, and non-GAAP diluted EPS dropped from $4.07 in 2022 to $3.12 in 2023.
